svg.title: tinycue: four real sentences through tinycue parse
svg.desc: A recorded terminal session. tinycue init writes a starter coffee machine, tinycue train builds the model in about three seconds, and four sentences are parsed: make me two lattes gives brew with cups 2 and drink latte at confidence 0.99, teen cup chai bana do gives brew with cups 3 and drink tea at 0.98, who won the match last night gives none at 0.98, and kindly cease the brewing apparatus comes back unsure with a best guess of none at 0.83.
